subject: Supplier staging invoice cadence and early-pay onramp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@elara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier staging invoice cadence and early-pay onramp

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. To keep procurement and AP teams aligned while we activate Elara as a Redwood supplier, we need to confirm three operational items so our finance and procurement systems can talk cleanly:

1) Invoice cadence and cutoff window (we typically route invoices by vendor to a daily ingest window; want to confirm your batch times and whether you can support a single monthly consolidated invoice if requested).
2) PO acknowledgement timing and field mapping (PO #, invoice-to GL, project tag).
3) Early-pay option onramp — if Elara wants to participate in our early-pay program, we need a T&C stub and sample invoice layout for our AP team to test remittance and discount calculation.

Attached: Redwood_earlypay_TnC_draft.pdf — a short draft showing our early-pay workflow. If you can send a sample invoice PDF (or export) and your preferred remit cut times, we can run a quick validation in our invoice ingestion sandbox next week.

Proposed next steps:
- You send sample invoice + remit window by EOD Monday 12/13.
- Kimberly will confirm PO ack template and any required field mappings by 12/14.
- I will schedule a 30-minute handoff call for 12/15 to validate the ingestion test.

Thanks — small asks, big impact on time-to-pay.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): Redwood_earlypay_TnC_draft.pdf
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@elara.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier staging invoice cadence and early-pay onramp

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — happy to align. Quick answers and I attached a representative invoice PDF (Elara_sample_invoice_v2.pdf).

- We generate invoices twice monthly (1st and 16th) generally by 03:00 PST; we can add a consolidated monthly invoice if Redwood requires that, but that would be an opt-in on our side.
- PO acknowledgements: we typically confirm within 48 hours. We support an "external_reference" field that can carry Redwood PO#s.
- Early-pay: we are open to the program. Our AP team needs to verify discount calculation and whether Redwood handles net terms change in the remittance portal.

I can get our AP ops person to join the handoff call on 12/15. Attaching Elara_sample_invoice_v2.pdf for your ingest team.

Best,
Samantha Cho
Head of Finance Operations
Elara Systems

Attachments: Elara_sample_invoice_v2.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@elara.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier staging invoice cadence and early-pay onramp

Marissa / Samantha —

I reviewed the sample invoice. A couple of practical items for our PO/invoice ingest:

- Please include the full PO number on line-item level if possible (we reconcile at line level for project tagging).
- We need a clear remit email and ACH details in the invoice header. If Elara prefers consolidated monthly invoices, confirm earliest delivery date (we can accept the 1st as long as cutoff is consistent).
- Attached is our PO_Ack_Template.xlsx — it lists required fields and the mapping keys our vendor ingestion API expects. If Elara's invoice mapping cannot populate every field, flag which fields you can suppress and we will add a temporary mapping rule for the sandbox run.

For early-pay: we usually run a 30‑day trial where Redwood pays on net-10 with a small fee and we validate settlement timing. If Elara is fine with the trial, please confirm acceptance of our T&C draft (Redwood_earlypay_TnC_draft.pdf) and we will prepare the DocuSign.

Thanks — I can run the sandbox test on 12/16 after the call.

—Kimberly
Sr. Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_Ack_Template.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@elara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier staging invoice cadence and early-pay onramp

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Samantha. Summary and agreed actions: 

1) Invoice cadence: Elara will opt into the twice‑monthly schedule for now (1st and 16th at ~03:00 PST). If you later want consolidated monthly, we can revisit.
2) PO ack / mapping: Elara will confirm which fields in PO_Ack_Template.xlsx they can populate by 12/14. Kimberly to add temporary mapping rules for missing fields.
3) Early-pay trial: Elara agrees to a 30‑day pilot (Redwood pays on net‑10, standard early‑pay fee applies). Samantha — please confirm acceptance of Redwood_earlypay_TnC_draft.pdf so we can route DocuSign.

Call planned: 12/15 11:00 AM PST — I will send an invite with the sandbox link.

If there are any blockers from Elara's AP team (ACH format, tax/1099 details), flag them on the call so we can remediate quickly.

Thanks all — feel free to reply inline if anything needs correcting.

Best,
Marissa

Related DocuSign: https://docusign.com/txn/abc123-elara-earlypay (will send final once Samantha confirms T&C)
